summary: Updated mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md: expanded csCloseModal() description to document csTriggerElement capture and focus restoration behavior (guarded, null-safe); removed the stale WCAG 2.1 SC 3.2.2 accessibility gap note (resolved by WP-001); updated csMoveStore() to document the corrected error-path (reverts optimistic swap, re-renders reorder view, calls csShowTableError — no csRefreshTab()); updated csShowTableError() to document dual-target behavior (#cs-table-error || #cs-reorder-error).

Updated mcp-server/gui/docs/agents/project-manifest/ui-components.md: added #cs-reorder-error to the reorder sub-view class table with ordering-invariant note; added .cs-sync-popover and .cs-sync-popover-visible rows to the badge classes table including the flip-left viewport-overflow guard behavior.
AC4 (gitRevList): not extracted — WP-007 QA confirmed the optional extraction was not performed. Criterion is trivially met (the 'if' condition is false).
Regenerated .context/ snapshots via node scripts/cli.js ctx-generate — completed successfully.
